query_text: A solo backpacking Asia diary app with that worn-in travel journal feel — warm sepia tones, handwritten-style fonts — where each country gets its own chapter and the home screen shows a beautiful map with little pins for every place I've been, all designed to feel gorgeous on my phone.
query_text_zh: 做一个独自背包穿越亚洲的旅行日记app，要有那种翻旧了的手账感——暖棕色调、手写风字体——每个国家单独一章，首页显示一张漂亮的地图，去过的每个地方都有一枚小图钉，整个app在手机上看要好看到让人爱不释手。

query_text: Build a dog adoption and training journey tracker — a mobile app that feels warm and joyful, like a scrapbook you'd actually want to flip through, where the home screen shows my dog's cutest photo front and center alongside a gentle timeline of training milestones and adoption anniversary moments.
query_text_zh: 做一个领养狗狗和训练历程记录app，风格要温馨有趣，像一本真的想翻来翻去的剪贴簿，首页正中间放狗狗最可爱的照片，下面是训练里程碑和领养周年纪念的时间轴。

query_text: Create a post-breakup recovery healing diary app for my phone that feels soft and gentle, like writing in a journal by candlelight — muted warm tones, calming typography — where I can log how I'm feeling each day and watch a little mood garden slowly bloom as I work through my healing.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个分手疗愈日记app，风格要柔和温暖，像在烛光下写日记的感觉——低饱和暖色调、平静的字体——可以每天记录心情，随着愈合过程，app里有一个小小的心情花园慢慢盛开。

query_text: Build a neighborhood street art photography logger — a mobile app that feels like a zine or an indie art book — where each piece of street art gets its own full-bleed photo card with the location and a short note, and the home screen looks like a gorgeous gallery wall of the city's hidden art.
query_text_zh: 做一个街头艺术摄影记录app，风格要像独立艺术杂志或zine——每件街头艺术作品都有一张全出血的照片卡片，标注位置和简短备注，首页看起来像一面城市隐秘艺术的画廊墙。

query_text: A travel memory scrapbook app for my phone that looks like those beautiful analog travel diaries you see in bookstores — layered textures, postcard-style photo cards, handwritten font accents — where memories are grouped by destination and the whole thing feels warm and curated, not like a generic photo grid.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个旅行记忆剪贴册app，要像书店里那种精美的模拟旅行日记——层叠的质感、明信片风格的照片卡、手写字体点缀——回忆按目的地分组，整体感觉温暖而精致，不像普通的照片网格。

query_text: Build a annual family photo album app for my phone where the home screen feels like opening a real coffee-table book — rich full-width photos, soft warm layouts — and each year has its own chapter with a cover image we pick ourselves, so flipping through it feels like a proper family keepsake.
query_text_zh: 做一个家庭年度相册app，首页打开就像翻开一本真正的精装画册——大幅全宽照片、柔和温暖的排版——每年单独一章，可以自己选封面图，翻阅时要有那种珍贵家庭纪念册的仪式感。

query_text: A baby growth milestone tracker app for my phone that looks and feels like a beautiful illustrated baby book — soft pastel tones, playful but tasteful typography — where each milestone like first smile or first steps gets its own little keepsake card with a photo and a short memory, arranged on a gentle timeline.
query_text_zh: 做一个宝宝成长里程碑记录app，要像一本精美的手绘婴儿成长册——柔和的马卡龙色调、活泼又不失品味的字体——第一次微笑、第一步路这些里程碑都有专属的纪念卡，附上照片和短短的文字，按时间轴排列。

query_text: A painting and artwork exhibition app for my phone that feels like stepping into a clean, airy gallery — plenty of white space, large artwork images that really breathe — where each piece has its own dedicated full-screen view with a title, medium, and a short artist note, and the home screen looks like a curated gallery entrance.
query_text_zh: 做一个画作和艺术品展览app，风格要像走进一家明亮整洁的画廊——大量留白、大尺寸的作品图——每件作品都有专属的全屏展示页，标注名称、媒介和艺术家手记，首页看起来像一个精心布展的展览入口。

query_text: Make a pet life chronicle app for my phone that feels like a gorgeous illustrated storybook dedicated to my cat — soft earthy tones, lots of heart and personality in the layout — where the home screen shows a beautiful hero photo and the timeline below captures daily moments with warmth and charm.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个宠物生活记录app，专门献给我的猫咪，风格要像一本精美的插画故事书——柔和的大地色调、版面充满温情和个性——首页放一张漂亮的主图，下面的时间轴温馨地记录每天的日常片段。

query_text: Create a pregnancy journey diary app for my phone that feels tender and luminous — soft blush and ivory tones, gentle rounded layouts — where each week has its own memory card for a belly photo and a short note, and the home screen shows a beautiful countdown to the due date surrounded by all the little moments so far.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个孕期日记app，风格要温柔而明亮——粉白色调、圆润的版面——每周都有一张记忆卡，可以放孕肚照和短短的文字，首页显示漂亮的预产期倒计时，周围环绕着这一路记录下来的小小瞬间。

query_text: A wedding anniversary gallery app for my phone that feels like a private love letter you can carry with you — romantic, elegant, warm — where every year's anniversary gets its own beautifully framed photo moment and a short note, and the home screen opens with a gorgeous full-bleed photo from the wedding day.
query_text_zh: 做一个婚礼周年纪念相册app，感觉要像一封随身携带的私密情书——浪漫、优雅、温暖——每一年的纪念日都有精美的照片框和简短记录，首页用一张婚礼当天的大幅全出血照片打开。

query_text: Make a childhood memory archive app for my phone that feels like finding an old tin box of photographs and letters in the attic — nostalgic, slightly faded, full of warmth — where memories are organized by age and each one gets its own aged-looking card with a photo, a quote, or a little story.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个童年回忆档案app，风格要像在阁楼上发现一盒老照片和信件——怀旧、略微泛黄、充满温情——回忆按年龄整理，每条都有做旧风格的卡片，放上照片、一句话或一段小故事。

query_text: Need a garden growth journal app for my phone that looks and feels like a beautiful botanical field notebook — lush greens, hand-drawn-style plant illustrations as accents — where each plant gets its own dedicated photo timeline so I can watch it grow week by week and add little notes about what I noticed.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个花园种植日记app，风格要像一本精美的植物学野外笔记——浓郁的绿色调、手绘风的植物插图作为点缀——每株植物都有专属的照片时间轴，可以一周一周地看着它生长，并随时添加观察笔记。

query_text: Make a road trip photo diary app for my phone that captures the golden-hour feel of driving through wide open landscapes — warm amber tones, film-grain texture on photos — where the home screen shows a winding road map of the route and each stop unfolds as a cinematic photo card with a few words about the moment.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个公路旅行照片日记app，捕捉在广袤大地上驾车行驶的黄金时刻感——暖琥珀色调、照片有胶片颗粒质感——首页展示路线的蜿蜒地图，每个停靠点展开为一张电影感的照片卡，配上几句当时的感受。

query_text: Need a festival and holiday album app for my phone that feels festive and alive — rich, saturated colors that shift with each holiday's vibe — where memories from Christmas, Lunar New Year, birthdays, and other celebrations each have their own beautifully styled chapter so the whole app feels like a year-round celebration book.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个节日庆典相册app，风格要喜庆又生动——饱和的色彩随着不同节日的气氛变化——圣诞节、春节、生日和其他庆典的回忆各有专属的精美章节，整个app读起来像一本全年庆典纪念册。

query_text: Create a fitness transformation gallery app for my phone that feels empowering and visually striking — bold, clean layout with strong before-and-after photo comparisons — where each milestone gets its own dedicated moment card with a date and a short note about how I felt, so the whole journey reads like a story of real change.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个健身蜕变记录app，风格要充满力量感、视觉冲击强——简洁有力的排版、前后对比照片清晰鲜明——每个里程碑都有专属的时刻卡，记录日期和当时的感受，整段旅程读下来就是一个真实改变的故事。

query_text: Need a study abroad memory book app for my phone that feels like a beautiful illustrated travel journal you'd actually display on a shelf — rich photography, layered with little mementos like ticket stubs and postcards as design details — where each city I lived in gets its own chapter full of moments, people, and discoveries.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个留学记忆相册app，风格要像一本精美的插画旅行日记，真的值得摆在书架上——丰富的摄影配上车票、明信片之类的小纪念品设计元素——在每个城市生活的那段时光各有一章，记录瞬间、人物和发现。

query_text: Build a hometown exploration logger — a mobile app that feels personal and full of local character, like a hand-curated city guide made just for me — where I can document hidden spots, neighborhood gems, and familiar haunts with photos and short notes, and the home screen shows a beautiful map dotted with all my discoveries.
query_text_zh: 做一个探索家乡的记录app，风格要有人情味、充满本地特色，像一本专属于我的手工城市指南——可以用照片和短文记录隐秘角落、街边宝藏和熟悉的老地方，首页是一张漂亮的地图，上面布满我的发现。

query_text: Create a food journey travelogue app for my phone that feels like a lush, mouth-watering food magazine — rich editorial photography, warm earthy tones — where each dish or restaurant I've loved gets its own beautiful story card with a photo, location, and a short note about why it moved me, grouped by the trip or city it belongs to.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个美食旅行游记app，风格要像一本丰盛诱人的美食杂志——精致的编辑感摄影、暖色大地色调——每道菜或每家心爱的餐厅都有专属的故事卡，附上照片、地点和短短一段打动我的理由，按旅程或城市分组。

query_text: Make a year in review slideshow app for my phone that feels like a beautifully edited personal short film — cinematic pacing, warm color grading on photos — where the best moments of the year are arranged in a flowing visual story with mood-appropriate typography and the whole thing feels like something worth sharing with people I love.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个年度回顾幻灯片app，风格要像一部精心剪辑的个人短片——电影化的节奏、照片有暖色调色——年度最美好的瞬间以流动的视觉故事呈现，配合氛围感字体，整体感觉像是值得分享给爱的人的珍贵东西。

query_text: A family reunion moments app for my phone that feels like a shared heirloom photo book the whole family helped make — warm, welcoming layout with big personality photos and space for little captions from different family members — where each reunion year has its own chapter and the home screen opens with the most beloved group shot.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个家族聚会相册app，像一本全家人共同完成的传家宝照片册——温馨热闹的版面、大张有个性的照片、每个人都能写一句话的空间——每年聚会单独一章，首页用最受珍爱的全家福打开。

query_text: Need a graduation achievement album app for my phone that feels like a proper keepsake worth being proud of — elegant but personal, with a mix of ceremony photos and behind-the-scenes moments — where accomplishments and milestones each get their own beautifully framed card and the whole thing reads like the end of an era worth celebrating.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个毕业纪念相册app，要像一本真正值得珍藏的纪念册——既优雅又有人情味，毕业典礼照片和幕后瞬间都有——每项成就和里程碑都有精美的专属卡片，整体读起来像一个值得庆祝的时代终章。

query_text: Need a seasonal life snapshots album app for my phone that feels like a curated editorial of my own everyday life — with each season having its own distinct visual mood, like spring gets soft greens and golden light while winter feels cozy and intimate — so scrolling through it feels like flipping through a beautiful personal magazine.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个四季生活快照相册app，像一本关于我自己日常生活的精选编辑——每个季节都有独特的视觉氛围，比如春天是柔和的绿和金色光线，冬天则是温馨私密的感觉——翻阅起来就像翻一本精美的个人杂志。

query_text: A adventure sports memory book app for my phone where the whole visual energy feels raw and alive — high-contrast action photos, bold typography, the kind of layout that actually matches the adrenaline of the moments — where each sport or trip gets its own dramatic chapter and the home screen hits you with the best shot right away.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个极限运动回忆相册app，整体视觉要有那种原始的生命力——高对比度的运动大片、粗犷有力的字体、版面要真的配得上那些肾上腺素飙升的瞬间——每个运动项目或旅程单独一章，首页直接用最震撼的照片打开。

query_text: Make a biomedical researcher publication page — a mobile app that feels like the kind of personal academic presence you're actually proud to share — clean, serious, and just a little elegant, where my publications are listed with enough context for someone to understand why my work matters, not just a dry reference list.
query_text_zh: 做一个生物医学研究员学术主页app——那种自己都愿意分享出去的学术形象展示——风格简洁、严肃中带一点优雅，论文列表要有足够的背景说明，让人看明白这项研究为什么重要，而不只是一堆干巴巴的引用。

query_text: Build a ceramics artist workshop showcase app for my phone where the home screen feels like stepping into a real studio — earthy tones, each piece gets its own card with the firing technique and a short story behind it, and there's a section that shows the workshop space itself so it has that handmade identity, not a sterile gallery.
query_text_zh: 做一个陶艺工作室作品展示app，首页要有走进真实工作室的感觉——大地色调、每件作品都有单独的卡片，注明烧制工艺和背后的故事，还有一个展示工作室空间本身的板块，让app散发出手作的质感，而不是冷冰冰的展廊风格。

query_text: Need a mobile app that collects financial planner success stories in a way that actually feels personal and worth reading — each story should have a before-and-after feel, the person's background, and what shift they made, laid out on your phone in a warm, human tone rather than a boring listicle.
query_text_zh: 帮我做一个理财顾问成功案例合集app，要真的有人情味、值得细读——每个案例都要有转变前后的对比、当事人的背景，以及他们做出的关键改变，在手机上以温暖真实的口吻呈现，而不是无聊的条目罗列。

query_text: Build a forensic science analyst profile app for my phone that feels precise and a bit cinematic — the kind of tool that shows someone's specialization, notable case types, and credentials in a way that carries real authority, with a clean layout that respects the seriousness of the work.
query_text_zh: 做一个法证科学分析师档案app，风格要精准且带点电影感——清晰展示专业方向、典型案件类型和资质证书，版面干净有权威感，体现出这份工作本身的严肃性。

query_text: Build a photography portfolio showcase app for my phone that has a real artistic identity — the home screen should feel like an opening frame, each photo series gets its own dedicated space with a short note about the shoot's mood or intention, and the whole thing should carry the photographer's personal aesthetic rather than looking like a stock template.
query_text_zh: 做一个摄影作品集展示app，要有真正的艺术个性——首页感觉像一个开场镜头，每个摄影系列都有专属空间，附上对这组照片情绪或创作意图的简短说明，整个app要体现摄影师自己的美学风格，而不是套模板的样子。

query_text: Build a UI/UX designer case studies app for my phone that actually shows the thinking behind the work — each case gets a before-and-after story with the design decisions explained in plain words, and the app itself should have a clean, tasteful look that reflects the designer's own sensibility rather than feeling generic.
query_text_zh: 做一个UI/UX设计师案例展示app，要真正呈现出设计背后的思考——每个项目都有设计决策的前后对比，用简单直白的语言解释，app本身的视觉风格也要干净有品位，体现设计师自己的审美，而不是千篇一律的感觉。

query_text: Create a graphic designer brand book app for my phone that feels like a real piece of creative identity — it should show the designer's signature colors, typefaces, and sample work in a way that has a strong point of view, so when someone opens it on their phone they immediately get a sense of who this person is and what they stand for aesthetically.
query_text_zh: 做一个平面设计师品牌手册app，要像一份真正有创意个性的自我名片——展示设计师的标志性色彩、字体和代表作品，整体有鲜明的观点，别人一打开就能感受到这个人是谁、审美立场是什么。

query_text: Need a resume and CV builder app for my phone that actually makes the output feel like it belongs to a real person with taste — let me fill in my background and experience, pick a layout that has some personality, and end up with something that looks considered and deliberate rather than a blank form someone filled out.
query_text_zh: 做一个简历制作app，让最终的成品真的像是一个有品味的真实的人做的——填入我的经历和背景，选一个有点个性的版式，最后得到一份看起来有想法、有设计感的简历，而不是随便填完的空表格。

query_text: An illustrator artwork gallery app for my phone where each piece gets room to breathe — the kind of mobile-first showcase that groups work by series or style, gives each illustration a proper title and a small note about the mood or medium, and feels like the illustrator's personal creative space rather than just a scrollable image dump.
query_text_zh: 做一个插画师作品展示app，每件作品都要有足够的呼吸空间——按系列或风格分组，每幅插画都有正式的标题和关于情绪或媒介的简短说明，整个app要像插画师自己的创作空间，而不只是一个可以滚动的图片堆。

query_text: Make a freelance copywriter samples app for my phone that shows off writing work with the right context — each sample should carry a short note about the brief and the voice it was written in, so the whole app feels like a curated reading experience with a distinct creative identity rather than a plain list of links.
query_text_zh: 做一个自由文案撰稿人作品集app，要用合适的语境展示写作样本——每个样本附上简报背景和使用的写作风格说明，让整个app读起来像一次有独特创意身份的精选阅读体验，而不是一堆链接的列表。

query_text: Need a mobile-first architect project portfolio app that carries a real sense of craft — the kind where each project gets a featured image, a short description of the concept and constraints, and the app as a whole has a restrained, thoughtful layout that feels as considered as the buildings themselves.
query_text_zh: 做一个移动端优先的建筑师项目作品集app，要有真正的工匠感——每个项目有主视觉图、关于方案概念和限制条件的简短描述，整个app版面克制而用心，感觉和建筑作品本身一样经过深思熟虑。

query_text: Make a fashion stylist lookbook app for my phone that feels like flipping through something with a real point of view — each look should be styled with intention, have a short note on the concept or season, and the overall app should have that editorial identity where the layout and color choices say something about the stylist's taste.
query_text_zh: 做一个时尚造型师lookbook app，翻阅起来要有真正的观点和立场——每套造型都有明确的风格意图，附上概念或季节说明，整个app要有那种编辑感，版面和用色本身就能传递造型师的品味。

query_text: Make an interior designer moodboard app for my phone that captures the feeling before a project starts — the kind of tool where you can browse rooms by style or palette, each moodboard has a short paragraph about the mood the designer was chasing, and the app itself feels warm and visually rich rather than clinical.
query_text_zh: 做一个室内设计师情绪板app，要能捕捉项目开始前的那种感觉——可以按风格或色调浏览空间方案，每个情绪板附上一段设计师追求的氛围描述，整个app要有温度、视觉丰富，而不是冷冰冰的工具感。

query_text: Make a video filmmaker reel app for my phone that has the right cinematic weight — the home screen should feel like a title sequence, each project gets a short description of the genre and the creative intent behind it, and the whole thing should have an identity that reflects the filmmaker's personal style rather than looking like a generic portfolio site.
query_text_zh: 做一个影像导演作品集app，要有恰当的电影分量感——首页感觉像一段片头，每个项目有类型和创作意图的简短介绍，整体要有能体现导演个人风格的视觉身份，而不是一个通用作品集网站的样子。

query_text: Build a product designer showcase app for my phone that lets the work speak with context — each project should have a clear story arc from problem to solution, with the design choices explained in honest everyday terms, and the app should carry a quiet confidence in its layout so it feels as considered as the products it's showing.
query_text_zh: 做一个产品设计师展示app，让作品在有背景的情况下说话——每个项目都有从问题到解决方案的清晰故事线，设计决策用真实朴素的语言解释，app本身版面要低调有自信，和它展示的产品一样经过认真考量。

query_text: Build a 3D artist portfolio app for my phone that does justice to the craft — the kind of mobile showcase where each piece gets a proper presentation with the project name, the inspiration behind it, and a sense of the texture and depth of the work, all wrapped in a layout that has its own strong visual identity.
query_text_zh: 做一个3D艺术家作品集app，要配得上这门技艺的水准——每件作品都有正式的展示，包括项目名称、创作灵感，以及传递出材质和纵深感的视觉呈现，整个app的版面要有自己鲜明的视觉身份。

query_text: Make a motion designer reel app for my phone that captures the energy of the work — each project gets a title, the tool or style used, and a short line about what the animation was meant to feel like, and the app itself should have a lively yet tasteful layout so it carries the same sense of motion as the work inside it.

query_text: Build a mobile app that presents an agriculture tech company profile in a way that feels like something worth keeping — clean layout on the home screen with the company story front and center, and a section for their core technologies that actually has a personality to it, not just a wall of text.

query_text: Need a mobile app that lays out a defense capabilities overview deck with the kind of seriousness and weight it deserves — a strong opening statement at the top, then each capability broken out in its own section with a visual that matches the gravity of the content, so the whole thing reads like something you'd actually want to hand someone.

query_text: Need a mobile app for presenting an annual report that feels like it was built with intention — something that carries the character of the company it represents, where the numbers and highlights live in a clean, well-paced layout you can actually read comfortably on your phone without feeling like you're staring at a spreadsheet.
query_text_zh: 需要一个展示年度报告的移动 app，要有一种精心设计的质感——能体现出公司本身的个性，数据和亮点放在排版整洁、节奏舒适的布局里，在手机上读起来不会让人觉得像是在看电子表格。

query_text: A client proposal showcase app for mobile that feels considered and confident, the kind of thing you'd actually want a client to open on their phone — the home screen lays out your strongest work upfront, and each proposal gets its own dedicated space with a clear story arc, not just a file dump.
query_text_zh: 做一个移动端的客户提案展示 app，风格要沉稳有自信，让客户打开手机就真的想看——首页直接展示你最强的作品，每个提案都有专属页面，呈现清晰的故事脉络，而不是随便堆几个文件。

query_text: Create a mobile app that presents a corporate brand identity in a way that actually reflects the brand — the kind of thing that opens with the logo and core colors like they mean something, then walks through the visual language in a way that feels deliberate and tasteful, something you'd be proud to share on your phone.
query_text_zh: 做一个移动 app，展示企业品牌形象，风格要真正体现品牌气质——一打开就是 logo 和核心色彩，感觉它们是有分量的，然后以克制而有品位的方式展示品牌视觉语言，是那种你愿意在手机上分享给别人看的 app。

query_text: Create a mobile app for showcasing a product catalog that has the look and feel of a real brand presentation — each product gets its own moment with a clean image and a short description that sounds like a human wrote it, with a consistent visual style throughout so the whole catalog feels like it belongs to something.
query_text_zh: 做一个移动 app，展示产品目录，要有真正品牌 presentation 的质感——每件产品单独呈现，配上干净的图片和听起来像真人写的短描述，整体视觉风格统一，让整份目录看起来像一个整体。

query_text: Create a mobile app for reading through an investment prospectus that feels like it respects your time — laid out on your phone in clean, digestible sections with the key numbers and terms surfaced in a way that's easy to find, and a visual style that says serious without being cold.
query_text_zh: 做一个在手机上阅读投资说明书的 app，要让人觉得你的时间被尊重——在手机上分成清晰、易消化的板块，关键数字和条款一眼就能找到，视觉风格严肃但不冰冷。

query_text: Make a mobile app that presents an NGO impact report with warmth and clarity — the kind that leads with the human story of what was accomplished, then walks through the numbers in a way that feels grounded rather than clinical, so anyone reading it on their phone comes away actually moved.
query_text_zh: 做一个移动 app，展示 NGO 影响力报告，要有温度和清晰感——先用真实的故事带出做了什么，再以接地气而非冷冰冰的方式呈现数据，让人在手机上读完真的有所触动。

query_text: Need a mobile app that works as a real estate property brochure with a look that matches the quality of the property — the kind that opens with a strong photo and a headline that sets the mood, then lets you scroll through key details and highlights in a way that feels curated, not rushed, all optimized for reading on your phone.

query_text: Make a mobile app that presents a franchise opportunity brochure with the confidence the opportunity deserves — opens with the brand front and center, then walks through what the model looks like and what makes it worth your attention, laid out on your phone in a way that feels polished and genuinely inviting.

query_text: Build a mobile app that presents an event sponsorship proposal with enough personality that sponsors actually want to read it — open with the event story and what it stands for, then lay out the sponsorship tiers in a way that feels clean and intentional, the kind of thing that looks great on a phone and carries its own identity.
query_text_zh: 做一个移动 app，展示活动赞助方案，要有足够的个性让赞助商真的想读——开头讲活动的故事和它代表的价值，然后把赞助级别呈现得干净而有质感，在手机上看起来出色，有自己的视觉身份。

query_text: Build a mobile app for viewing a partnership deck where the presentation itself feels like an extension of the relationship it's pitching — strong cover with the two sides clearly represented, then a clean progression through the shared vision and terms, all readable on your phone with the kind of pacing that keeps you engaged to the end.

query_text: A corporate culture showcase app for mobile that actually captures what makes a place worth working at — opens with the values in a way that sounds real rather than HR-speak, then moves through team stories and key moments with a visual rhythm that feels alive and genuine, the kind of app you'd actually want to share on your phone.

query_text: A tech product feature overview app for mobile that feels like the product itself cares about design — each feature gets its own clear moment with a visual and a one-line explanation that actually means something, laid out in a flow that feels natural on your phone so you understand what the product does by the time you reach the bottom.

query_text: Need a mobile app that works as a hotel and venue brochure where the atmosphere comes through on a small screen — opens with the right mood photo and a short line that sets the tone, then flows through the spaces and offerings in a way that feels intentional and inviting rather than just a list of room types.
query_text_zh: 需要一个作为酒店和宴会场所宣传册的移动 app，氛围感要在小屏幕上也能透出来——一打开就是对的意境大图和一句定调的短语，然后以精心而温馨的方式展示各个空间和服务，而不只是罗列房型列表。

query_text_zh: 需要一个作为媒体资料包和新闻页的移动 app——顶部有干净的品牌声明，然后以整洁易导航的方式组织 logo、简介和媒体报道，让记者在手机上就能直接找到所需的一切，不用到处翻。

query_text: Make a mobile app for presenting a consulting firm profile that carries the weight and intelligence of the work they do — opens with the firm's perspective on what they're good at, then showcases practice areas and key people in a way that feels human and considered, the kind of thing worth reading all the way through on your phone.
query_text_zh: 做一个展示咨询公司介绍的移动 app，要有与其工作分量和专业深度相称的气质——先讲公司擅长什么的视角，再以有温度、有质感的方式展示业务板块和核心成员，是那种在手机上值得从头读到尾的 app。

query_text: Create a mobile app that serves as a trade show exhibit guide with a character that matches the event it represents — the kind that opens with a map or overview you can actually read on your phone, then lets you tap into each exhibitor or zone with just enough information to make you want to go there, all with a visual feel that belongs to this particular show.

query_text: Need a mobile app for reading a sustainability report that actually makes you feel something — not just tables and percentages but a real visual narrative where the progress feels tangible, the goals feel grounded, and the whole thing reads on your phone in a way that's honest and worth your time.

query_text_zh: 做一个记录摄影史的移动 app，视觉风格要致敬摄影这门艺术——暗房氛围的色调，时间线像翻动老相册一样推进，每个里程碑配一张照片和短故事，让你感受到那个瞬间的重量，整体在手机上看起来要对得上这门艺术。

query_text: Need a mobile app that brings the Maritime Exploration Age to life with rich visuals — like the feel of old nautical maps and weathered logs — where each explorer's voyage gets its own beautifully styled entry with a sense of drama and era, and I can tap through different expeditions to see the routes and stories in a way that feels immersive, not like a textbook.

query_text_zh: 做一个呈现科学发现时间线的移动 app，浏览起来要真的有美感——每项突破有自己的卡片，视觉氛围与所处时代相匹配，在手机上滑动浏览科学史就像穿越不同的世界，每条条目有足够的背景让你明白这项发现为何重要。

query_text: Create a mobile app that works as a cultural festival guide, with a warm and festive visual feel — the home screen shows festivals from around the world as rich visual tiles, each with its own color mood and vibe, and tapping one opens a full guide with the story behind the celebration, what to expect, and the sensory atmosphere so you actually feel transported before you even go.
query_text_zh: 做一个文化节庆指南的移动 app，视觉要温暖又有节日感——首页把全球各地的节庆以丰富的视觉卡片呈现，每张卡片有自己的色彩基调和氛围，点进去有完整的介绍，讲节庆背后的故事、现场体验和感官氛围，让你还没出发就已经感觉身临其境。

query_text: Create a mobile app for browsing literary author profiles that feels like wandering through a beautifully curated bookshop — each author gets a full profile with a portrait, the mood and world of their writing, and their most celebrated works displayed in a way that feels editorial and considered, so reading about an author on your phone feels as inspiring as reading the books themselves.
query_text_zh: 做一个浏览文学作家档案的移动 app，感觉像是在一家精心布置的书店里闲逛——每位作家有完整的个人页面，附有肖像、其写作世界的氛围与风格，以及以编辑视角呈现的代表作，让在手机上了解一位作家像读他们的书一样令人着迷。

query_text: Make a mobile app that chronicles space exploration with a dark, cinematic feel — the kind of visual atmosphere that makes you feel the scale and wonder of the cosmos just by scrolling through it on your phone, where each mission or milestone gets its own immersive entry with dramatic imagery and a narrative that captures the human story behind the science.
query_text_zh: 做一个记录航天探索历史的移动 app，视觉风格要暗黑、史诗感十足——光是在手机上滑动浏览就能感受到宇宙的尺度与震撼，每项任务或里程碑有自己的沉浸式页面，配上震撼的图像和捕捉科学背后人类故事的叙述。

query_text: Create a mobile app for deep-diving into ancient civilizations where the whole experience feels like stepping into another world — earthy, textured visuals that evoke the aesthetic of each culture, and a flow that lets you move through different civilizations at your own pace, with each one revealing its architecture, beliefs, and daily life in a way that feels rich and alive rather than encyclopedic.
query_text_zh: 做一个深度探索古代文明的移动 app，整体体验要像踏入另一个世界——大地色、有质感的视觉风格唤起每个文化的美学气质，流程让你按自己的节奏穿行于不同文明之间，每个文明以鲜活而非百科全书式的方式展示其建筑、信仰和日常生活。

query_text: Build a mobile app that serves as a companion guide for documentaries, with a visual style that matches the mood of serious, cinematic storytelling — where each documentary gets a dedicated space with key themes, notable quotes, and background context laid out beautifully so you can explore the topic more deeply on your phone after watching, with a feel that honors the craft of the documentary itself.
query_text_zh: 做一个纪录片伴读指南移动 app，视觉风格要配得上严肃、电影感的叙事氛围——每部纪录片有专属页面，核心主题、精彩引言和背景资料以精美的排版呈现，让你在手机上看完后可以深入探索这个话题，风格要向纪录片本身的创作精神致敬。

query_text: A mobile app that works as an archive of local folklore, designed with the kind of handmade, storybook aesthetic that makes the legends feel alive — each entry on your phone has its own illustrated atmosphere and mood, and the stories are laid out in a flowing, readable style that pulls you in, with categories for different types of folklore so you can wander through myths, ghost stories, and folk traditions separately.
query_text_zh: 做一个整理本地民间传说的移动 app，要有手工制作、绘本故事书那种让传说充满生命力的美学——每条条目在手机上有自己的插画氛围和基调，故事以流畅可读的方式铺展，让你不知不觉读进去，并按不同类别分类，让你可以分开浏览神话、鬼故事和民俗传统。

query_text: Make a mobile app that acts as a digital guide for museum exhibits, with the quiet, refined visual feel of a well-curated gallery space — the home screen is a beautiful overview of different exhibit themes, and tapping into one gives you a richly illustrated deep-dive with context, artifact highlights, and the story behind the collection, all optimized for browsing on your phone while you explore.
query_text_zh: 做一个博物馆展览数字导览移动 app，要有精品画廊那种静谧而精致的视觉质感——首页是不同展览主题的精美概览，点进某个展览后有图文丰富的深度介绍，包含背景信息、重点文物和藏品背后的故事，全程为在手机上边逛边看进行优化。

query_text: Need a mobile app that profiles great philosophy thinkers in a way that feels intellectually beautiful — not dry and academic, but like a visually considered editorial with portrait imagery, the core ideas of each thinker presented with visual breathing room, and a tone that makes their philosophy feel relevant and alive, so you can browse famous thinkers on your phone and actually feel inspired.
query_text_zh: 需要一个介绍伟大哲学家的移动 app，风格要有智识之美——不是枯燥学术风，而是像一本视觉考究的编辑读物，有肖像图像，每位思想家的核心观点有充分的视觉呼吸空间，语气让他们的哲学感觉贴近当下、充满活力，在手机上浏览时真的能感到启发。

query_text: Build a mobile app for exploring music era retrospectives where each decade or movement gets its own distinct visual mood — the aesthetics shift as you move through eras, so browsing from jazz to punk to electronic on your phone feels like actually traveling through time, with key artists and albums highlighted in a beautifully styled way that captures the energy and look of each period.
query_text_zh: 做一个探索音乐时代回顾的移动 app，每个年代或音乐运动有自己独特的视觉氛围——美学风格随时代切换，在手机上从爵士到朋克再到电子乐，感觉像真正在穿越时空，核心艺术家和专辑以精心设计的方式呈现，捕捉每个时期的能量和视觉语言。

query_text: Build a mobile app for film director retrospectives where the visual identity of each director's work is reflected in how their profile is presented — so Kubrick's page feels different from Wong Kar-wai's, with signature color palettes and imagery that evoke their films, and a curated filmography laid out in a way that feels cinematic and personal, all optimized for reading on your phone in a focused, beautiful way.
query_text_zh: 做一个电影导演回顾展移动 app，每位导演作品的视觉风格要融入其个人页面的呈现方式——库布里克的页面感觉和王家卫的不一样，用标志性色彩和影像唤起他们的电影气质，精心策划的作品目录以电影感、个人化的方式呈现，全程针对手机阅读优化，专注而精美。

query_text: An art movement explainer app for mobile where each movement — Impressionism, Bauhaus, Surrealism — gets its own visual identity that actually reflects the aesthetic of that movement, so browsing through art history on your phone feels immersive and tasteful, with signature works shown in context alongside the ideas and cultural moment that gave rise to each movement.
query_text_zh: 做一个艺术运动解说移动 app，每个运动——印象派、包豪斯、超现实主义——都有能真正反映该运动美学的视觉身份，让在手机上浏览艺术史既沉浸又有品位，代表作品在上下文中展示，同时呈现催生每个运动的思想和文化时刻。

query_text: A mobile app for deep-diving into natural wonders where the visual experience matches the scale and beauty of the subject — lush, full-bleed imagery that makes you feel the atmosphere of each place on your phone, with a flowing narrative structure that covers what makes each wonder unique, the science behind it, and the cultural stories attached to it, all presented with a sense of editorial care and wonder.
query_text_zh: 做一个深度探索自然奇观的移动 app，视觉体验要配得上主题的壮阔与美丽——沉浸式的满屏大图让你在手机上就能感受每个地方的氛围，叙事结构流畅，涵盖每处奇观的独特之处、背后的科学以及相关的文化故事，整体以编辑级别的细心和敬畏感呈现。

query_text: Build a mobile app that guides users through World Heritage Sites with a visual richness that does justice to the places — the home screen feels like a stunning gallery of the world's most remarkable locations, and each site's entry has a layered, beautifully composed layout on your phone with history, cultural significance, and the sensory feeling of actually being there, not just facts and dates.
query_text_zh: 做一个世界遗产地导览移动 app，视觉丰富度要对得上这些地方的分量——首页像一个展示全球最非凡地点的精美画廊，每处遗产地的页面在手机上有层次丰富、构图精美的布局，涵盖历史、文化意义和身临其境的感官描述，不只是枯燥的数字和年份。

query_text: A mobile-first app profiling famous scientists where the visual style feels as precise and elegant as the discoveries themselves — each scientist's page has a portrait with a warm, considered atmosphere, a timeline of their key breakthroughs, and a narrative that captures the human curiosity behind the science, all laid out with enough visual care that browsing on your phone feels genuinely delightful.
query_text_zh: 做一个移动端优先的知名科学家介绍 app，视觉风格要像他们的发现一样精准而优雅——每位科学家的页面有一张氛围温暖、用心拍摄的肖像，一条关键突破时间线，以及捕捉科学背后人类好奇心的叙事，排版用心到在手机上浏览也是真正的享受。

query_text: Create a mobile app that celebrates traditional craft heritage with a warm, artisan aesthetic — think handmade textures, earthy tones, and the kind of visual feel that honors the craft itself, where each tradition gets a beautifully presented entry with the story of its origins, the techniques involved shown through rich imagery, and the cultural meaning behind the craft, all designed to feel like a lovingly made object on your phone.
query_text_zh: 做一个传承传统手工艺的移动 app，美学要温暖、有匠人气息——手工质感、大地色调，那种视觉风格本身就是对工艺的致敬，每项传统有精美呈现的专页，讲述起源故事、通过丰富图像展示技法，以及这门手艺背后的文化意义，整体在手机上像一件用心制作的器物。

query_text: Make a mobile app that tells the history of political movements through a visually striking, editorial lens — the design should feel bold and evocative, with each movement's page capturing the visual atmosphere of its era and the energy that drove it, so reading about labor rights or civil rights history on your phone feels visceral and alive, with a timeline and key figures woven into a compelling visual narrative.
query_text_zh: 做一个以视觉冲击力强的编辑视角讲述政治运动历史的移动 app——设计要大胆而充满感染力，每个运动的页面要捕捉到那个时代的视觉氛围和驱动它的力量，让在手机上阅读劳工权利或民权运动历史时有真实的震撼感，时间线和关键人物融入引人入胜的视觉叙事中。

query_text: A mobile architecture storyteller app where famous buildings get their own beautifully composed profiles — full-bleed imagery that captures the mood and grandeur of each structure, with the story of its design, the architect's vision, and the cultural moment it emerged from laid out in a way that feels as considered as the buildings themselves, all optimized for browsing on your phone with a quiet, refined visual taste.
query_text_zh: 做一个建筑故事移动 app，知名建筑有各自精心构图的专属页面——满屏大图捕捉每座建筑的氛围和气势，设计故事、建筑师的创作理念以及它诞生的文化时刻以与建筑本身同样考究的方式呈现，全程针对手机浏览优化，有一种安静而精致的品位。

corpus_topic: Community event with ticketing and capacity limit
query_text: Make a mobile app for organizing community events where I can set up an event, add a ticket limit so it doesn't get overbooked, and let people sign up right from their phones — I want it to show how many spots are left so people know if they need to hurry, and it should be simple enough that even someone who's never used an events tool before can figure it out in a minute.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机端的社区活动组织 app，可以创建活动、设置名额上限防止超员报名，让大家直接在手机上报名——要显示剩余名额让人知道是否需要抓紧，而且要足够简单，从没用过活动工具的人一分钟内也能上手。

corpus_topic: Language deck creation with spaced-repetition schedule
query_text: Create a mobile flashcard app where I can build my own language learning decks by adding new words and phrases one by one, and it automatically figures out when to show me each card again based on how well I know it — kind of like it remembers which ones I keep getting wrong and brings those back more often, all usable on my phone whenever I have a spare few minutes.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机闪卡 app，可以自己建语言学习词组，一条一条添加单词和短语，然后它自动根据我的掌握程度决定什么时候复习哪张卡——就是能记住哪些我总记不住，然后更频繁地把那些拿出来考我，随时有几分钟空余就能在手机上用。

corpus_topic: Investment watchlist ticker add with price alert
query_text: Make a mobile stock watchlist app where I can search for a ticker and add it to my list, then set a price alert so my phone notifies me when it hits a certain number — I just want to keep an eye on a handful of stocks I care about and get a heads-up when the price moves to where I want to pay attention.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机端的股票自选股 app，可以搜索股票代码加进我的列表，然后设置价格提醒，当它涨到或跌到某个价位时推送通知——就想盯着几只我关注的股票，价格到位了手机提醒我一声。

corpus_topic: HR leave request with document and coverage attach
query_text: Need a mobile app for submitting leave requests at work where I can fill in the dates, add a note about why I'm out, attach a document if HR needs one, and also put down who's covering for me while I'm gone — something simple I can do from my phone without having to email back and forth or dig up a paper form.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机端提交工作请假申请的 app，可以填写请假日期、写请假原因、上传 HR 需要的证明文件，还能填写代班人是谁——不用来回发邮件或者翻出纸质表格，直接在手机上搞定。

corpus_topic: Insurance claim with photo evidence upload
query_text: Need a mobile app for filing insurance claims where I can take photos of the damage right from my phone and attach them to the claim, with a step-by-step form that walks me through the incident details, injury info, and lets me review everything before submitting.
query_text_zh: 想要一个手机保险理赔app，可以直接用手机拍摄损坏照片并附到理赔单上，通过分步骤的表单引导我填写事故详情和伤情信息，最后提交前能预览确认所有内容。

corpus_topic: Property inspection checklist with severity scoring
query_text: Build a property inspection checker app for my phone that goes room by room through a checklist of things to look at, and for each issue I find I can mark how bad it is — like minor, serious, or critical — so at the end I get a clear summary of what needs fixing most urgently.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机房产验收checklist app，按房间逐一检查，每发现一个问题可以标记严重程度——比如轻微、严重或紧急——最后生成一份清晰的汇总，显示哪些问题最需要优先处理。

corpus_topic: Grant application new submission with file attach
query_text: A grant application tool for mobile that walks you through each part of the submission one step at a time — project description, budget, team info — and lets you attach supporting files like PDFs or spreadsheets along the way before you hit submit.
query_text_zh: 想要一个手机端的助学金申请工具，分步骤引导填写每个部分——项目描述、预算、团队信息——还能随时附上PDF或表格等支撑材料，填完后一键提交。

corpus_topic: Podcast episode wizard with chapter marks
query_text: Build a podcast episode planner app for my phone that takes me through setting up a new episode step by step — title, description, guest info — and lets me add chapter marks with timestamps so listeners can jump to different parts of the episode.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机播客单集规划app，一步步引导我设置新一期内容——标题、简介、嘉宾信息——还能添加带时间戳的章节标记，方便听众跳转到不同片段。

corpus_topic: Blog post SEO metadata and slug update
query_text: Create a blog editor tool for mobile where I can quickly go in and update the SEO title, description, and the URL slug for any post without having to dig through a bunch of settings, so my articles actually show up properly in search results.
query_text_zh: 想要一个手机端的博客编辑工具，能快速修改任意文章的SEO标题、描述和URL slug，不用翻一堆设置，让文章能在搜索结果中正常显示。

corpus_topic: Shared document collaborative edit with conflict resolve

query_text_zh: 做一个手机端的多人协同文档编辑app，支持多人同时编辑，当两个人修改了同一处内容时，app显示两个版本让你选择保留哪个，而不是直接覆盖。

query_text_zh: 做一个手机库存管理app，可以批量选中多个商品，一次性更新尺寸、颜色、重量或价格，不用一个个打开单独改。

corpus_topic: Employee performance review update with comment thread

query_text_zh: 做一个手机绩效考核管理app，管理员可以修改员工的评分和留言，员工也能在同一对话里回复，所有反馈集中在一处，不用在邮件里翻来翻去。

corpus_topic: Vehicle maintenance record update with mileage

query_text_zh: 想要一个手机汽车保养记录app，记录每次保养的里程数、项目和费用，根据上次保养以来跑了多少公里，自动提醒下次换油或换胎的时间。

query_text_zh: 做一个手机租约编辑app，并排显示现有合同条款和我想修改的内容——比如租金、租期或养宠政策——可以标注修改项，在谈判过程中留下清晰的变更记录。

query_text_zh: 需要一个手机冲刺计划app，显示当前冲刺中的所有任务，点击任意一条即可快速修改故事点估算，让整个团队在站会时能随时用手机更新数据，不用挤在一台电脑前。

query_text_zh: 想要一个手机社交媒体排期管理app，按日期列出所有待发帖子，点进任意一条未发出的帖子可以修改文字或替换图片，保存后不影响原定发送时间，方便在发布前最后一刻纠错。

query_text_zh: 做一个手机端的用户查找app，可以按用户名或真实姓名搜索，拉出对方的主页、简介和近期动态列表，点击可跳转至完整主页——适合只记得对方部分用户名时找人。

query_text_zh: 需要一个手机消费查询工具，可以按消费类型筛选交易记录——比如超市、餐厅或订阅服务——还能设置金额范围，精准定位某笔可疑账单，不用翻好几个月的流水。

query_text_zh: 需要一款手机app，让我能用几下点击把线上生产环境的所有配置复制到测试环境，不用每次都手动重新填写那些配置项，省得每次都要让测试环境和生产环境保持一致。

corpus_topic: Product bundle copy with new pricing
query_text: A mobile product manager tool where you can take an existing bundle, duplicate it, and update just the pricing and included items for the new version — so launching a new seasonal offer means tweaking a copy instead of building the whole bundle listing from scratch every time.
query_text_zh: 想要一款手机产品经理工具，支持复制现有套餐，只修改新版本的定价和包含项目——这样推出新的季节性活动只需要在副本上微调，不用每次都从头创建整个套餐。

corpus_topic: Invoice line item copy to new invoice
query_text: Build a mobile invoicing app where you can copy all the line items from a previous invoice straight into a new one with a single tap, so you stop manually re-entering the same services and prices every time you bill a recurring client on your phone.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机开票app，支持一键把上一张发票的所有行项目复制到新发票里，不用每次给老客户开发票都在手机上重新输入相同的服务和价格。

query_text: Need a mobile shift scheduling app that lets me duplicate the whole weekly rotation pattern and apply it to the next week, so I stop manually re-entering every single person's shift assignments every time a new week starts.
query_text_zh: 需要一款手机排班app，支持复制整个每周轮班方案并应用到下一周，不用每次新的一周开始都手动重新填写每个人的班次安排。

query_text: Build a mobile grading tool for teachers where you can save a rubric template once and then copy it for each new assignment, adjusting the criteria as needed, so you stop rebuilding the same grading structure from scratch on your phone every time you create a new project.
query_text_zh: 做一款面向教师的手机评分工具，可以把评分量表模板保存一次，之后每次新作业直接复制并按需调整评分标准——不用每次在手机上创建新项目时都从头搭评分结构。

corpus_topic: Home screen widget add and resize
query_text: Need a mobile app that lets me customize a home screen layout by adding little info tiles — like a weather spot, a quick notes box, a countdown timer — and resize each one to fit however much space I want to give it, so my phone's home feels actually useful and personal to how I work.
query_text_zh: 需要一款手机app，让我能自定义主屏幕布局，添加各种小信息卡片——比如天气、快速记事本、倒计时——还可以自由调整每个卡片的大小，让手机主屏幕真正好用，符合我自己的使用习惯。

query_text: Create a mobile setup guide app that walks new users through turning on helpful accessibility options step by step — things like bigger text, voice control, or high contrast mode — with a friendly walkthrough that explains what each setting actually does so someone who's never touched these options can figure it out without feeling lost.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机新手设置引导app，带用户一步步开启有用的无障碍功能——比如放大字体、语音控制、高对比度模式——配有友好的引导说明，解释每项设置的实际作用，让从没接触过这些选项的人也能轻松搞定，不会手足无措。

corpus_topic: App permissions audit and revoke manager
query_text: Create a mobile privacy manager app that shows you a clear list of all the other apps on your phone and what permissions each one has — like camera, location, contacts — so you can see at a glance which apps have access to things they probably shouldn't, and turn off the ones you want to revoke right from the same place.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机隐私管理app，清晰列出手机上所有其他app及其各项权限——比如摄像头、位置、通讯录——让你一眼看出哪些app获取了不该获取的权限，并能在同一个界面直接撤销你不想授予的权限。

corpus_topic: Bluetooth device pairing and name assignment
query_text: Make a mobile Bluetooth manager tool that scans for nearby devices, walks you through pairing them step by step, and lets you give each paired device a nickname so you always know which device is which — especially handy when you have several speakers or earbuds and they all show up with confusing model numbers.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机蓝牙管理工具，支持扫描附近设备、一步步引导完成配对，还能给每个已配对的设备起个昵称——特别实用，尤其是有好几个音箱或耳机、型号名称又一堆数字让人搞不清楚的时候。

query_text: Need a mobile calendar sync tool that lets me connect my Google, Outlook, or iCloud calendars in one place on my phone and see all my events together in a single view, with a simple setup flow that shows exactly which accounts are linked and lets me turn each one on or off whenever I want.
query_text_zh: 需要一款手机日历同步工具，可以在一个地方连接Google、Outlook或iCloud日历，把所有日程合并到一个视图里查看，设置流程简单直观，能看清哪些账号已连接，并随时开关每个账号。

corpus_topic: Cross-platform data import and mapping flow
query_text: Build a mobile data importer tool that lets you bring in a file from another app or service, then walks you through matching up the columns or fields to where they should go in the new place, so you can move your stuff between apps on your phone without everything ending up in the wrong spot.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机数据导入工具，支持从其他app或服务导入文件，然后引导你把字段或列对应到新位置，这样在手机上跨app迁移数据时就不会搞错位置了。

query_text: Need a mobile link chooser tool that pops up when you tap a shared link and shows you all the apps that could open it, letting you pick where you actually want to go each time rather than always getting sent to the wrong place automatically — especially useful when links could go to a web browser, a native app, or a mini-program.
query_text_zh: 需要一款手机链接选择工具，点击分享的链接时弹出选择框，列出所有可以打开该链接的app，让你每次都能手动选择去哪里，而不是总被自动跳转到不想打开的地方——尤其适合那些可以用浏览器、原生app或小程序打开的链接。

corpus_topic: In-app live chat support widget launch
query_text: Live chat support button that pops up on my mobile app so users can tap it and instantly talk to someone — want it to feel like a little floating helper that's always there in the corner, and when they tap it opens up a chat window where they can type their problem and get a reply right away.
query_text_zh: 想要在我的手机app里加一个在线客服按钮，用户点一下就能立刻和客服聊天——希望它是一个悬浮在角落里的小助手按钮，点击后弹出聊天窗口，用户可以直接输入问题，马上得到回复。

query_text: Need a lumber board feet calculator app for my phone where I can punch in the thickness, width, and length of a board and it instantly tells me the volume in board feet, so I stop having to do the math myself every time I'm at the lumber yard.
query_text_zh: 需要一款手机木材板英尺计算器app，输入木板的厚度、宽度和长度，立即得出以板英尺为单位的体积，这样在木材市场就不用自己手动算了。

query_text: Build a road trip fuel cost estimator app for mobile where I type in the trip distance, my car's miles per gallon, and the current gas price, and it tells me roughly what I'll spend on fuel so I can plan my budget before I hit the road.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机公路旅行油费估算app，输入行程距离、油耗和当前油价，算出大概要花多少油钱，方便出发前做好预算规划。

corpus_topic: Cooking Measurement US to Metric Converter
query_text: Build a cooking measurement converter app for my phone that lets me quickly flip between US cups, tablespoons, and teaspoons to grams and milliliters, because I keep running into recipes that use metric and I always have to Google it mid-cook.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机烹饪计量单位转换app，快速在美制杯、汤匙、茶匙和克、毫升之间换算，因为经常遇到用公制的食谱，每次都要中途去Google查太麻烦了。

query_text: Make a retirement safe withdrawal rate calculator app on mobile where I put in my total savings and expected years in retirement, and it shows me how much I can safely pull out each year so I don't run out of money before I die.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机退休安全提款率计算器app，输入总储蓄和预计退休年限，计算出每年可以安全取出多少钱，确保钱花不完。

query_text: Need a time zone meeting scheduler app for my phone where I can pick a few cities and a time, and it shows me what time it is in each place so I can find a slot that works for everyone on my team without having to do the mental math myself.
query_text_zh: 需要一款手机时区会议时间安排app，选几个城市和一个时间，显示各地对应的本地时间，帮我找到所有团队成员都方便的时间段，不用自己脑子里换算了。

query_text: Need a photo print resolution calculator app for my phone where I enter my image pixel dimensions and the print size I want, and it tells me the resulting DPI so I know if the photo will actually look sharp when I print it out.
query_text_zh: 需要一款手机照片打印分辨率计算器app，输入图片的像素尺寸和目标打印尺寸，计算出对应的DPI值，让我知道打印出来是否足够清晰。

query_text: Create a knitting yarn yardage estimator app for my phone where I can enter the project type, yarn weight, and needle size, and it calculates roughly how many yards I'll need so I buy the right amount and stop running out halfway through a project.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机编织毛线用量估算app，输入项目类型、毛线粗细和针号，算出大概需要多少码，这样买毛线时买够，不会做到一半没线了。

corpus_topic: Musical BPM and Time Signature Helper
query_text: Build a music BPM and time signature helper app for my phone where I can tap to find the tempo of a song or type in a BPM and see what the note values work out to, so I can figure out timing when I'm practicing and don't have my metronome handy.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机音乐BPM和拍号辅助app，可以通过点击测速或直接输入BPM，然后看到各种音符时值对应的时长，练琴时没有节拍器也能搞清楚节奏。

corpus_topic: Currency converter with live exchange rates
query_text: Create a currency converter app for my phone that shows up-to-date exchange rates so I can quickly see what my money is worth in another currency when I'm traveling or shopping online from a foreign store.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机汇率换算app，显示实时汇率，出行或在海外网店购物时能快速看清钱换成其他货币值多少。

corpus_topic: Tip and bill splitter with custom share per person
query_text: Build a bill splitter and tip calculator app for my phone where I enter the total, choose the tip percentage, and then set a custom amount or percentage for each person at the table, so everyone pays exactly what they owe and I stop being the one doing mental math at dinner.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机AA制账单和小费计算器app，输入总金额、选择小费比例，再为每人设置各自应付的金额或比例，让大家各付各的，我也不用在饭桌上一直在脑子里算了。

corpus_topic: Baby Feeding and Diaper Change Log
query_text: Need a baby feeding and diaper change logger app for my phone where I can tap one button to log a feeding with the time and amount, and another button for diaper changes, so I can actually remember what happened overnight and tell the doctor when they ask.
query_text_zh: 需要一款手机婴儿喂养和换尿布记录app，一个按钮记录喂奶时间和奶量，另一个记录换尿布，这样半夜发生了什么我能记得清楚，医生问起来也能回答上来。

query_text: Create a social interaction diary app for my phone where I can jot down who I talked to each day, how the conversation went, and how I felt afterward, so I can look back over the week and see which kinds of interactions gave me energy and which ones drained me.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机社交日记app，每天记录和谁聊过天、聊得怎么样、聊完的心情，这样回顾一周时就能看出哪类社交让自己充满能量、哪类让自己精疲力竭。

corpus_topic: Weather and Outfit Daily Match Log
query_text: Create a daily weather and outfit log app for my phone where I record what the weather was like and what I actually wore that day, so over time I can look back and figure out what to wear on similar days instead of standing in front of my closet guessing.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机天气与穿搭日志app，记录当天天气状况和实际穿了什么，时间久了回头一查就能知道类似天气该穿什么，不用站在衣柜前干猜了。

query_text: Need a focus session logger app for my phone where I can start a timer when I sit down to do deep work, add a note about what I worked on, and then look back at my weekly log to see how many solid hours I actually put in each day.
query_text_zh: 需要一款手机专注时间记录app，坐下来做深度工作时启动计时器，添加一条工作内容备注，之后查看每周记录，看看自己每天实际有多少小时在认真投入。

query_text: Build a daily new words logger app for my phone where I can quickly add a word I just learned along with its meaning and a short example sentence, so I can review my list later and actually remember the words I picked up while studying a new language.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机每日生词记录app，快速添加刚学到的单词、释义和一个例句，方便之后回顾，真正记住学外语时积累的新词汇。

query_text: A little chore tracker app for my phone where I can check off which household tasks I did each day — like vacuuming, dishes, laundry — and see a simple history of the past week so I can tell which chores I've been skipping and build a better cleaning routine.
query_text_zh: 想要一款手机家务打卡app，每天勾选完成了哪些家务——比如吸尘、洗碗、洗衣服——并查看过去一周的完成记录，看看哪些活一直在拖，养成更规律的清洁习惯。

query_text: A sleep quality log app for my phone where every morning I can tap a quick rating from terrible to great, add an optional note about how I feel, and then see a simple chart of my ratings over the past couple of weeks to spot patterns in what's affecting my rest.
query_text_zh: 想要一款手机睡眠质量记录app，每天早上快速点一个从差到好的评分，可选填备注感受，然后查看过去几周的评分折线图，发现影响睡眠质量的规律。

corpus_topic: Daily Step and Active Minutes Recorder
query_text: Need a daily steps and active minutes recorder app for my phone where I can manually enter my step count and how many minutes I was actually moving around, then see a simple weekly summary so I can tell whether I'm hitting my activity goals or slacking off.
query_text_zh: 需要一款手机步数和活动时间记录app，可以手动输入步数和活动分钟数，查看每周汇总，了解自己是否达到了运动目标，还是一直在偷懒。

corpus_topic: Daily mood tracker with emoji and freetext note
query_text: Create a daily mood tracker app for my phone where I pick an emoji that matches how I'm feeling and optionally type a quick note about why, then see a little calendar view of my past moods so I can notice if there's a pattern to when I feel good or low.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机每日情绪追踪app，选一个符合当下心情的emoji，可以选填一句简短的原因说明，然后查看过去的日历视图，发现自己情绪好坏的规律。

corpus_topic: Food photo diary with calorie estimation
query_text: Create a food photo diary app for my phone where I can snap a photo of what I ate, give it a rough calorie estimate, and add a short note, so I have a visual log of my eating habits over time and can see if I'm roughly on track without obsessing over exact numbers.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机饮食拍照日记app，拍下吃了什么，填个大概热量，加条简短备注，留存一份可视化的饮食记录，随时回顾看看自己的饮食是否大体达标，不用纠结精确数字。

query_text: A gift idea recommender app for my phone where I answer a few quick questions about the person's personality and interests, and it gives me a list of gift suggestions that actually fit who they are, so I stop defaulting to gift cards every birthday.
query_text_zh: 想要一款手机礼物推荐app，回答几个关于对方性格和兴趣的小问题，就能得到一份真正贴合这个人的礼物建议，不用每次过生日都只会送购物卡。

query_text: Create a party guest introduction card generator app for my phone where I type in each guest's name and a fun fact or two, and it spits out a little card for each person so guests can learn something about each other and actually start conversations at my next gathering.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机派对嘉宾介绍卡生成app，输入每位来宾的名字和一两个有趣的小故事，生成一张小卡片，让大家互相了解，在下次聚会上真正聊起来。

query_text: Make a long-distance friendship activity planner app for my phone where my friend and I can browse a list of things we can do together remotely — like watching a movie at the same time or playing an online game — and pick one to schedule so we actually follow through instead of just saying we'll hang out soon.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机异地友谊活动规划app，我和朋友可以浏览一份可以远程一起做的事情清单——比如同步看电影或一起玩线上游戏——选一件约好时间去做，不然就只会一直说"改天一起玩"却总是没下文。

corpus_topic: Social Media Caption and Emoji Generator
query_text: Make a social media caption and emoji generator app for my phone where I describe a photo or moment in a few words and it comes up with a few catchy captions with matching emojis, so I stop staring at my phone trying to think of something clever to write before posting.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机社交媒体文案和emoji生成app，简单描述一下照片或场景，就能生成几条有亮点的配文和匹配的emoji，不用发帖前对着手机想半天写什么。

query_text: Need a mobile app that helps me figure out what to say in tough conversations — like asking for a raise, setting a boundary with a friend, or telling someone something they don't want to hear — where I pick the situation and it walks me through a script I can actually use, with a spot to jot notes before I go in.
query_text_zh: 想要一款手机app，帮我想清楚在棘手对话里该说什么——比如跟老板谈涨薪、跟朋友划清界限、或者告诉别人他们不想听的事——我选好场景，它给我一套可以直接用的话术脚本，还有个地方让我在开口前记几条小提示。

query_text: Make a mobile app that helps me get ready before walking into a networking event, where I can quickly jot down who I'm hoping to meet, what I want to say to each person, and a few conversation starters so I'm not just standing there awkwardly with my drink.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机app，帮我在走进社交活动之前快速做准备——我可以记下想认识哪些人、对每个人想说什么，还有几个开场白，这样就不用尴尬地端着杯子不知道怎么接话了。

query_text: Create a holiday card message maker app for my phone where I can pick the occasion — Christmas, New Year's, birthdays — type in the person's name, and get a warm personal message I can copy and send, with a way to save my favorites for later.
query_text_zh: 做一款节日贺卡文案生成app，可以选场合——圣诞、新年、生日——输入对方的名字，就能得到一段温馨又有个人味道的祝福语，可以直接复制发出去，还能把喜欢的存下来备用。

query_text: Need a mobile app that throws out fun team building activity ideas when my team is feeling stuck — I tap a button, it suggests something based on team size and whether it's in-person or remote, and I can save or share the ones that sound good.
query_text_zh: 需要一款手机app，当团队陷入僵局时能随机给出有趣的团建活动建议——点一下按钮，它根据团队人数和线上线下情况推荐活动，我可以保存或分享觉得不错的方案。

query_text: Build a compliment and encouragement generator app for my phone where I tap a button and it gives me a genuine, uplifting message I can send to a friend or coworker, with options to pick the mood — like motivational, funny, or heartfelt — so it fits the moment.
query_text_zh: 做一款夸夸与鼓励生成app，点一下按钮就能得到一句真诚温暖的话发给朋友或同事，还可以选情绪风格——比如激励系、搞笑系或走心系——让它更贴合当下的氛围。

corpus_topic: Bar or Board Exam Prep Countdown
query_text: A bar exam prep countdown timer app for my phone that feels serious and focused — like a clean dark background with big bold days-remaining numbers front and center, plus a small study checklist underneath so I can see at a glance how much time is left and what I still need to tackle.
query_text_zh: 想要一款手机上的司法考试备考倒计时app，风格要沉稳专注——深色简洁背景，正中间显示醒目的剩余天数大字，下面有个小小的学习清单，让我一眼就能看到还剩多少时间、还有哪些内容没搞定。

query_text: Build a visa and immigration deadline tracker app for my phone that has a calm, organized feel — where I can add each important date like renewal deadlines, interview appointments, and document submission cutoffs, and see them laid out in a clear timeline so nothing sneaks up on me.
query_text_zh: 做一款签证和移民截止日期追踪app，风格要冷静有条理——可以添加各类重要日期，比如续签截止日、面试预约日、材料提交截止日，并以清晰的时间轴形式展示，这样就不会有任何事情猝不及防地扑过来。

query_text: Create a sobriety milestone counter app for my phone that feels warm and encouraging — where I set my clean date and it shows me the days, weeks, and months I've made it through, with little celebration moments when I hit meaningful milestones like 30 days or a full year.
query_text_zh: 做一款戒断里程碑计数app，风格要温暖有鼓励感——我设好戒断起始日期，它就显示我已经坚持了多少天、多少周、多少个月，当我达到30天或整整一年这样有意义的里程碑时，给我一个小小的庆祝时刻。

query_text: A military deployment return countdown app for my phone that feels hopeful and tender — showing the days ticking down until my loved one comes home, with a spot to write little notes or messages for each day that I could share when they're back, and a soft warm color palette that feels like waiting with love.
query_text_zh: 做一款军人部署归来倒计时app，风格要充满希望和温柔——显示亲人回家还有多少天，并有个地方可以为每一天写下小小的话语或留言，等他们回来后可以分享给他们，配色要柔和温暖，就像带着爱在等待。

query_text: Make a lease renewal tracker app for my phone that looks clean and easy to read — where I can enter my lease end date and it shows how many days I have left, with gentle reminders as the deadline gets closer, and a place to note important things like notice period and landlord contact.

query_text: Build a product launch countdown app for my phone that has that exciting, anticipation-building vibe — a big striking clock ticking down to launch day, somewhere to list the launch milestones I'm working toward, and a look that feels like hype and momentum so I stay pumped about the whole thing.

query_text: Build a music album or book release countdown app for my phone that captures that electric anticipation feeling — a beautiful cover image front and center, a big countdown showing days and hours until drop day, and a vibe that feels like the aesthetic of the release itself, moody or colorful depending on what I set.

query_text: A space mission launch countdown app for my phone that feels cinematic and thrilling — deep space dark background with a glowing countdown clock ticking toward liftoff, a short blurb about the mission, and that sense of awe and scale like you're actually watching history happen from your couch.

query_text: A festival and holiday season countdown app for my phone that feels festive and joyful — showing all the upcoming holidays and festivals across the year with colorful cards for each one, a countdown for the nearest celebration, and a warm seasonal aesthetic that shifts as the year changes, like spring pastels fading into cozy winter tones.
query_text_zh: 做一款节日和假期季节倒计时app，风格要喜庆欢乐——用彩色卡片展示全年即将到来的各个节日和庆典，并显示距最近那个节日的倒计时，整体视觉风格随季节流转而变化，就像春天的柔和马卡龙色渐渐过渡到冬日的温暖舒适色调。

query_text: Make a mobile app that lets me enter two or three different email subject lines and quickly compare them side by side so I can figure out which one sounds more clickable before I hit send, with a spot to add notes about why I prefer one over the other.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机app，让我输入两三个不同的邮件主题行，快速并排对比，看看哪个更吸引人想点击，在发送前拿定主意，还有个地方可以记下为什么更偏好某一个。

query_text_zh: 做一款手机拼写和语法检查工具，可以把我写的内容粘贴进去——草稿邮件、消息、报告都行——它直接高亮出错误并给出修改建议，让我快速改好，不用打开另一个编辑器或来回复制粘贴。

query_text: Make a mobile text summarizer tool that I can paste any long article or document into and it spits out a short summary plus a bullet list of the key points, so I can get the gist of something in thirty seconds instead of reading five pages when I'm on the go.

query_text: Create a password generator tool for my phone where I can pick the length and whether I want symbols or numbers mixed in, and it generates a strong password I can copy with one tap, plus shows a little strength meter so I know it's actually secure before I use it.

query_text_zh: 做一款手机可读性检测工具，把我写的内容粘贴进去，它告诉我文章有多容易读懂——比如Flesch分数和对应的年级水平——这样我就能看出邮件或文章是不是太晦涩，然后调整到普通人也能轻松看懂。

query_text_zh: 做一款手机随机配色方案生成app，点一下按钮生成一套搭配好看的颜色，显示对应的十六进制色码方便直接使用，还能锁定某个喜欢的颜色、随机刷新其余颜色，帮我为小品牌或项目找到最完美的配色组合。

query_text: Build a vacation destination roulette app for my phone where I can add a list of places I've been wanting to visit, spin a big wheel, and it lands on one destination and shows me a little summary card with what that place is known for so I can finally stop being indecisive about where to go next.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机旅行目的地转盘app，把我想去的地方列进去，转动大转盘，它停在某个目的地后显示一张简介卡，说说那个地方有什么特色，帮我终于下定决心去哪，不再拖延纠结。

query_text_zh: 做一款手机版桌游事件生成app，点一下按钮随机弹出一个游戏内场景或意外事件卡——非常适合自制桌游玩到一半需要加点意外元素时使用，可以选几个类别，比如天气事件、剧情反转或额外挑战。

query_text_zh: 做一款手机骰子和抛硬币模拟器app，可以掷不同面数的骰子——比如六面、八面或二十面——也可以抛硬币，每次都有小动画，屏幕底部有一个历史记录列表显示最近几次的结果。

query_text_zh: 做一款手机单手模式切换app，从屏幕底部上滑可以把所有按钮和内容下移到下半屏，这样只用大拇指就能够到所有东西，再往上滑一下就能回到正常的全屏布局。

query_text_zh: 做一款手机语音导航app，我可以直接说"打开设置"或"进入我的笔记"，它就能理解并跳转过去，主屏幕还有一个小列表显示所有可用的语音指令，让我知道它能听懂哪些话。

query_text_zh: 需要一款手机app，让我通过注视屏幕不同区域来操作——盯着某个按钮或链接几秒钟就自动触发，这样可以免提使用手机，还有一个设置页面可以调整触发所需的注视时长。

query_text_zh: 做一款手机阅读辅助app，把我粘贴进去的任何文字用更简单的日常用语重新表达，同时以左右对比的方式显示原文和简化版，这样我可以对照着读，不会看着看着就迷失了。

query_text: Create a product Q&A app for my phone where shoppers can ask questions about a product and sellers can reply directly in a thread under each question, so buyers can see the full back-and-forth conversation and get the answers they need before buying.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机上的商品问答app，买家可以对商品提问，卖家可以在该问题下的对话串中直接回复，让其他买家也能看到完整的一问一答，在购买前获得所需信息。

corpus_l2_key: ① 商品详情/规格选择
query_text: Make a mobile product showcase app where each product page has a short demo video right there in the listing, so shoppers can watch it play on their phone without leaving the page — I want the video to show the product actually being used.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机上的商品展示app，每个商品页面直接内嵌一段使用演示短视频，买家在手机上就能在不离开页面的情况下观看——我希望视频展示的是商品的实际使用场景。

query_text: Build a shopping cart app for my phone that handles split delivery, meaning if I have items going to different addresses like home and office I can split them into separate shipments at checkout and see the delivery details for each one.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机上的购物车app，支持拆分配送，也就是说如果我的商品要寄到不同地址（比如家和公司），可以在结账时拆分成多个包裹，分别查看每个包裹的配送信息。

query_text: Make a mobile checkout app that pulls up my saved addresses when I'm ready to pay so I can just tap the one I want instead of typing it out every single time — I want to be able to add a new address too if I'm sending somewhere new.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机结账app，付款时自动调出我保存的收货地址，一键选择，不用每次重新输入——如果要寄到新地址，也能方便地添加。

corpus_topic: Return request with label print flow
query_text: Build a return request app for my phone that walks me through the whole return process step by step — I pick the item, say why I'm returning it, and at the end it shows me a shipping label I can print or share with the post office to send it back.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机上的退货申请app，引导我一步步完成整个退货流程——选择要退的商品、说明退货原因，最后生成一张可以打印或出示给快递员的退货面单。

query_text: Refund tracker app for my phone that shows exactly where my refund is at right now and a simple timeline of what's already happened and what's coming next, so I can stop wondering when the money is actually hitting my account.
query_text_zh: 做一款手机退款进度追踪app，实时显示我的退款目前处于哪个环节，并用简洁的时间轴展示已完成的步骤和即将发生的步骤，让我不用一直猜钱什么时候到账。
